service.notShipped: The helper service is not next to the app. Reinstall the app to get it.
service.installFailed: The helper service could not be installed. The app works in proxy mode.
service.missing: The helper service is not installed: Tunnel mode is unavailable, Proxy mode works.
service.starting: The helper service is starting… Tunnel mode will be available in a few seconds.
service.stopped: The helper service is stopped: Tunnel mode is unavailable for now, Proxy mode works.
service.refused: Another program answers in place of the helper service, so the app does not talk to it.
